text.description_html:
Brass Accents A04-K2000, 5-7/8 Inch American Bald Eagle Door Knocker

What better way to show your patriotism than with the American Eagle Door Knocker? The Eagle's wings are spread and his head is turned in the classic pose making this Bald Eagle Knocker look as if it belong on the front doors of the White House. Classic styling, timeless beauty, and enduring quality are all hallmarks of Brass Accents. The Solid Brass American Eagle Door Knocker is made by a craftsman. It measures 5-7/8 inches high with 3-1/8 inch mounting center to centers.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance. Their products are hand finished in the USA. They are one of the world's leading crafters of cast-brass and hot-forged decorative brass hardware.

Specifications of the Bald Eagle Door Knocker:

  • Height: 5-7/8"
  • Width: 5-7/8"
  • Mounting Centers: 3-1/8" Horizontal
  • Max Thickness: 1-1/4"
  • Solid Brass

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
